Features:

Mask personal data, then enqueue the `check` workflow.

Args:
    request: text (up to 4000 characters), a full http(s) link or an audio id.
    jobs: the job queue port.
    gate: the shared rate limits and the pending-checks threshold.
    origin: the client address and region the limits count.
    pii: the personal-data masking gate.
    readiness: the readiness probe; a service that is not ready refuses checks.
    session: the random browser session id; no sign-in needed.

Returns:
    The check id, 422 with a copy key, or 503 NotReady.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 without a valid session or for Discord, SMS and MCP
        (they come through their adapters with a hashed user id, backend#27),
        503 when the job queue is unreachable.
    CheckRefusedError: over a rate limit or with too many pending checks;
        answered 429 with Retry-After, nothing enqueued.

Features:
    US-SPR-01, US-SPR-07, US-BEZ-02, US-BEZ-03, US-BEZ-04, US-WDR-03, US-WDR-08,
    F-01, F-20, F-23, F-30

Raises:

Features:

get.description:
Stream a check's progress until the workflow ends.

A result reaches the client only once ``verify_citations`` is done or
skipped, so a preliminary answer never carries a verdict. When the workflow
finished, the last event holds the full CheckResult and the stream closes.
The response has no AI-Disclosure header: headers go out before the first
event, when no result is known yet; ``result.ai_disclosure`` marks it.

Args:
    jobs: the job queue port.
    check_id: the id POST /api/v1/checks returned; 404 when unknown.
        Opening a stream counts against the address's own stream budget
        (429 above it).

Yields:
    One AnalysisStatus per progress value, then the final one with ``result``.

Features:
    US-SPR-02, US-BEZ-02, F-09, F-20

post.description:
Store a recording for the check record's retention and return its id.

The bytes decide the format (core's ``inspect_audio``), not the MIME type.
Public, so limited per client address (429 above AUDIO_UPLOAD_LIMIT).

Args:
    request: the request; its body is the file (OGG Opus, MP3, M4A or WAV).
    blobs: the blob store port.

Returns:
    The audio id, or AudioRejected: 413 over MAX_AUDIO_BYTES, 422 over
    MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS, 415 for any other file.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 503 when the store fails.

Features:
    US-SPR-11, F-08, ADR-13, ADR-31

delete.description:
Delete the checks of one browser session („Usuń moje sprawdzenia”).

The random session id in the path is the key: only its holder knows it, so
a session reaches only its own records. The header is optional (the
extension does not send it); when sent it must name the same session, which
catches client mistakes, not attackers. Limited per client address.

Args:
    request: the request; slowapi reads the client address from it.
    session_id: the random browser session id.
    jobs: the job queue port.
    eraser: the app's SubjectEraser.
    session: the caller's session id, when sent.

Returns:
    How many records and notifications were deleted right away.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 when the header names another session, 400 for an id
        that is not a browser session id, 503 when the queue or the
        database is unreachable (429 above the limit comes from slowapi).

Features:
    US-BEZ-05, US-BEZ-06, US-POW-04, F-20

post.description:
„Przekaż moderatorom”: turn a recommendation into a saved case.

Limited to HANDOFF_LIMIT per client address (429 above that).

Args:
    request: the request; slowapi reads the client address from it.
    jobs: the job queue port.
    check_id: the finished check.
    claim_index: the claim's position in the check's result.
    response: the response; gets 503 when no case was saved.

Returns:
    The case created or joined with its number and escalation.created or
    escalation.updated; with 503, escalation recommended (no number) and
    escalation.recommended when the case was not saved.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the check is not finished or has no such claim.

Features:
    US-MOD-03, F-24, ADR-22

„Zgłoś błąd”: a case with reason user_dispute and a masked justification.

The stored result does not change; a moderator reviews the dispute first.
Limited to HANDOFF_LIMIT per client address (429 above that).

Args:
    request: the request; slowapi reads the client address from it.
    jobs: the job queue port.
    check_id: the finished check.
    claim_index: the claim's position in the check's result.
    response: the response; gets 503 when no case was saved.
    pii: the personal-data masking gate.
    dispute: the person's optional reason, masked here before the workflow
        starts; no body or a blank reason sends none.

Returns:
    The case with its number and result.report_error_done; with 503,
    escalation recommended (no number) when the case was not saved.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the check is not finished or has no such claim.

Features:
    US-MOD-06, F-24, ADR-22

AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus
AnalysisStatus.description: Polled (or streamed) by every channel while a check runs; mirrors the DBOS workflow.

AnalysisStep.title: AnalysisStep
AnalysisStep.description: One step of the processing strip shown between „Sprawdź” and the result.

AudioAccepted.title: AudioAccepted

AudioRejected.title: AudioRejected
AudioRejected.description:
413, 415 or 422 answer: no recording to check, so no verdict.

Attributes:
    status: always ``out_of_scope``, as core's UnsupportedAudioError.
    message_key: errors.audio_too_large, errors.audio_too_long or
        status_hint.out_of_scope_audio_format (copy/pl.json).
    formats: the formats that can be sent ({formats} of form.audio_limits).
    max_mb: the size limit ({max_mb} of the copy).
    max_minutes: the length limit ({max_minutes} of the copy).

Features:
    US-SPR-11, F-08

CaseClaim.title: CaseClaim
CaseClaim.description: One claim in a case and the checks that asked it: unanswered ("insufficient_evidence"), or disputed by a user.

CheckAccepted.title: CheckAccepted
CheckAccepted.description:
202 answer: the check was queued.

Attributes:
    check_id: the id to poll at GET /api/v1/checks/{check_id}.

Features:
    US-SPR-01, F-01

page_url.title: Page Url
page_url.description: Extension only: the post the text came from.

audio_id.title: Audio Id
audio_id.description: Uploaded audio file or Discord voice message; transcribed in an EU region, then checked like text.

channel_user_id.title: Channel User Id
channel_user_id.description: Discord, SMS and MCP only: user id, phone number or MCP client id. The API hashes it with a salt into channel_user_hash and never stores it.

session_id.title: Request Session Id
session_id.description: Web and extension only: random id kept in the browser session; the API copies it to CheckRecord.session_id.

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest
CheckRequest.description: What a channel adapter sends to the verification core. The core is channel-agnostic.

message.title: Message
message.description: For non-verdict statuses: what to do next.

failure_code.title: Failure Code
failure_code.description: technical_failure only; never names a key or a provider.

limitation_codes.title: Limitation Codes
limitation_codes.description: Codes next to the limitation texts; the channel words them from copy/pl.json. They never change the status.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: Audio input only: the automatic transcript, with personal data masked.

corpus_version.title: Corpus Version
corpus_version.description: Id of the scheduled corpus snapshot.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult
CheckResult.description:
The answer every channel renders. The same normalised input within the result cache's lifetime gets the same substantive result on every channel.

out_of_scope: an unsupported input type or a request that is not about information. needs_clarification: no claim
could be extracted. Any factual claim gets a verdict, "insufficient_evidence" included.

validity.title: Validity
validity.description: Age rule for this piece of evidence: the catalogue entry's validity, or past_event / superseded set per evidence.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A fragment of a source and how it bears on the claim. The pipeline drops fragments it cannot find verbatim.

claim_date.title: Claim Date
claim_date.description: The date the claim refers to; evidence age is measured against it.

claim_review_premises.title: Claim Review Premises
claim_review_premises.description: IFCN or EFCSN fact-checkers' ratings that back the verdict without a page fragment (ADR-34).

would_change_verdict.title: Would Change Verdict
would_change_verdict.description: What would change the verdict, computed by a rule from the premises; the channel words it from copy/pl.json.

archival.title: Archival
archival.description: Newest evidence is older than the claim's context needs.

ClaimResult.title: ClaimResult
ClaimResult.description: One checked claim. Citations (source material) are kept apart from `explanation` (model interpretation).

ClaimReviewContext.title: ClaimReviewContext
ClaimReviewContext.description:
A fact-checker's ClaimReview rating found through Google Fact Check Tools API, shown as context with a link.

Never a citation, never counted towards strength, kept no longer than the API's cache headers allow.

signatory_of.title: Signatory Of
signatory_of.description: IFCN or EFCSN membership from the publisher's catalogue entry; required for a premise.

fetched_at.title: Fetched At
fetched_at.description: When Google Fact Check Tools API returned it.

ClaimReviewPremise.title: ClaimReviewPremise
ClaimReviewPremise.description:
A fact-checker's ClaimReview rating used as a premise of the verdict, next to the citations (ADR-34).

Found through Google Fact Check Tools API. It has no page fragment: the rating, title,
date and link are the evidence. Only publishers the catalogue lists as IFCN or EFCSN
signatories qualify; the pipeline copies `signatory_of` from their catalogue entry.
Counted per publisher like a secondary-tier citation.

DeletedChecks.title: DeletedChecks
DeletedChecks.description:
202 answer: the deletion ran and the worker got the rest.

Attributes:
    deleted: check records and notifications deleted right away; DBOS data
        and files follow in the ``delete_subject`` workflow.

Features:
    US-BEZ-05, F-20

Dispute.title: Dispute
Dispute.description:
Body of „Zgłoś błąd”.

Attributes:
    justification: what the person thinks is wrong, optional (a blank one
        counts as none, over JUSTIFICATION_INPUT_MAX_CHARS is refused);
        masked, then cut to MAX_JUSTIFICATION_CHARS before any marker.

Features:
    US-MOD-06, F-24

Enqueued.title: Enqueued
Enqueued.description:
Answer to an accepted job.

Attributes:
    workflow_id: the id to poll at GET /api/v1/jobs/{workflow_id}.

Features:
    ADR-03

Escalation.title: Escalation
Escalation.description:
Hand-off to the moderator queue. 'recommended' means nobody was notified yet.

Computed on every request, cache hits included: the result cache never stores it.

EvidenceStrength.title: EvidenceStrength
EvidenceStrength.description: Strength level together with the premises it follows from.

Handoff.title: Handoff
Handoff.description:
The hand-off's outcome as the citizen sees it.

Attributes:
    escalation: created or updated with the case number, or recommended
        without one when no case was saved.
    message_key: the copy/pl.json key to show; never says who else asked.

Features:
    US-MOD-03, US-MOD-06, F-24

HighRiskTopic.title: HighRiskTopic
HighRiskTopic.description:
One topic of the admin's high-risk list, with its fallback keywords.

A case whose claim falls under the topic gets the ``high_risk`` reason; the
keywords classify it when the model cannot.

Attributes:
    name: the topic, as ``ModeratorCase.high_risk_topic`` names it.
    keywords: the words that mark a claim as this topic.

Features:
    US-MOD-05, F-20

database.title: Database
database.description: fact_check: the entry matched an already checked publication.

match_basis.title: Match Basis
match_basis.description: What agreed; shown with the match.

IncidentMatch.title: IncidentMatch
IncidentMatch.description:
Similarity to a known incident (organiser's database, the local EUvsDisinfo copy or a checked fact-check). Context only.

Never a basis for the verdict by itself, and never changes it. An EUvsDisinfo `fact` text is cited as a Citation,
not carried here.

`domain` is the one explicitly defined warning case: the checked URL is on a domain the incident database lists
(for EUvsDisinfo: linksToDisinformation), and the incident's topic matches the claim. A content match needs a
matching title, topic and date; the domain alone never makes one. `match_basis` lists what matched and is shown.

InvalidCheck.title: InvalidCheck
InvalidCheck.description:
422 answer: what the person must fix, as a key of copy/pl.json.

Attributes:
    message_key: errors.empty, errors.too_long or errors.invalid_url.

Features:
    US-SPR-01, US-SPR-07, F-01

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description:
What the caller may see about one job.

Attributes:
    workflow_id: the DBOS workflow id.
    status: the DBOS workflow status (ENQUEUED, PENDING, SUCCESS, ERROR,
        CANCELLED, ...).
    output: the workflow result as JSON, once it succeeded.
    error: the error text, once it failed.

Features:
    ADR-03

Me.title: Me
Me.description:
The signed-in account and the token for state-changing requests.

Attributes:
    provider: the provider name.
    subject: the provider's account id.
    email: the e-mail address from the ID token.
    email_verified: whether the provider verified the address.
    csrf_token: the value to send in ``X-CSRF-Token``.

Features:
    US-MOD-05, US-SPR-10, F-25

high_risk_topic.title: High Risk Topic
high_risk_topic.description: Topic from the admin's high-risk list that matched.

high_risk_classified_by.title: High Risk Classified By
high_risk_classified_by.description: Embedding similarity to the admin list above a threshold, or the keyword list as a fallback (ADR-35).

distinct_askers.title: Distinct Askers
distinct_askers.description: Distinct sessions or users who asked; raises the case's priority only, never decides whether it exists.

ModeratorCase.title: ModeratorCase
ModeratorCase.description: One case per group of similar unanswered claims. Similarity is measured per claim; a repeated claim joins the case.

NotReady.title: NotReady
NotReady.description:
503 answer to a check while the service is not ready; names no keys.

Attributes:
    status: always technical_failure, which is not a verdict.
    code: always not_ready.
    message_key: the copy/pl.json key to show.

Features:
    US-WDR-08, US-BEZ-03, F-30

PingInput.title: PingInput
PingInput.description:
Input of the `ping` smoke-test workflow.

Attributes:
    message: text the worker echoes back.

Features:
    ADR-03

independent_sources.title: Independent Sources
independent_sources.description: Distinct publishers (publisher_id) among the citations whose stance agrees with the verdict.

primary_sources.title: Primary Sources
primary_sources.description: Distinct primary-tier publishers among the agreeing citations.

newest_source_published_at.title: Newest Source Published At
newest_source_published_at.description: Publication date of the newest agreeing source, shown as a date.

newest_source_age_hours.title: Newest Source Age Hours
newest_source_age_hours.description: Hours from the newest agreeing source to the claim date (ClaimResult.claim_date), not to now; 0 when the source is newer.

max_age_hours.title: Max Age Hours
max_age_hours.description: Threshold from the catalogue entry of the newest source.

Premises.title: Premises
Premises.description: Explicit premises behind a verdict (MSZ: strength must follow from quality, recency, agreement, independence).

Readiness.title: Readiness
Readiness.description:
Body of GET /api/v1/health: what the API and the worker lack.

Attributes:
    status: ok when nothing is missing, otherwise degraded.
    env: the environment name.
    database: whether the API's database role can run a query.
    worker: whether the worker published its readiness report.
    missing_env: names of unset required variables (API and worker).
    unavailable_providers: providers the API or the worker cannot use.

Features:
    US-WDR-08, US-BEZ-03, F-30

publisher_id.title: Publisher Id
publisher_id.description: Publisher id from the catalogue; independence is counted on it.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A document from the audited corpus. Title, publisher, date and link are mandatory to show (MSZ section 2).

SourceStatusWarning.title: SourceStatusWarning
SourceStatusWarning.description: Neutral note that the checked content comes from an entity on the official EU sanctions list. Never a verdict.

StaffAccount.title: StaffAccount
StaffAccount.description:
A panel role an administrator granted to an e-mail address.

Attributes:
    email: the address the OIDC provider must confirm (and verify).
    role: the role in the moderator panel.

Features:
    US-MOD-05, F-25

StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description:
The signed-in person and their role in the panel.

Attributes:
    email: the verified address from the ID token.
    role: the role from the configuration or from an administrator.

Features:
    US-MOD-05, F-25

TooManyChecks.title: TooManyChecks
TooManyChecks.description:
429 answer: a message for people, never a verdict.

Attributes:
    message_key: errors.rate_limited or errors.busy (copy/pl.json).

Features:
    US-BEZ-02, US-WDR-03, F-20, F-23
